definitions.full: H1001. bira בִּירְתָא (Baer תָּא -) noun feminine emphatic castle (so Egyptian Aramaic RevS 361. A 5; B 1, 2 S-C Pap. B 3, C 16 +; Nabataean = temple CIS ii. 164. 3 ; Biblical Hebrew בִּירָה ); — Ezra 6:2 .
